title: Chinese-Style Beef and Tomato Wrap
description: A twist on traditional Chinese flavors, served in a crispy wrap with tender beef and fresh tomato.
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together light soy sauce, irish butter, ginger, and garlic.
Add the beef strips to the marinade and mix well.
Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Add the beef and cook until browned, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the diced tomato to the skillet and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
Warm the wrap according to package instructions.
Assemble the wrap by spreading the cooked beef and tomato mixture onto the center of the wrap.
Top with green onions and serve immediately.
